title: THE SAME MINE
description: This is the minecraft that you want to play all the time.
body:
_**JUST VANILLA MINECRAFT AND NOTHING ELSE (Not exactly)!**_

![THE SAME MINE](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d906f86c68d067e309af3c33ffa3c95ed1e623be.jpeg)

My modpack adds various resource packs and mods for mob and player animations, mods that improve game performance, and mods that affect game mechanics such as [NetherPortalFix](https://modrinth.com/mod/netherportalfix) and [Bridging Mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/bridging-mod)

The functionality of my modpack is very similar to the vanilla game, making it more visually appealing

Why you should choose my modpack: good FPS even on a weak PC, pleasant Minecraft style WITHOUT SHADERS (see the pictures), beautiful interface, animation of mobs and players, and much more!

A simple modpack does not have much weight does not load your computer.
